intitule: Exercise 3: Talking About Weather in Cameroon

enonce.texte: Describe the weather in three different cities in Cameroon using the present simple.

questions.reponse: Example: Douala is hot and humid. It is usually rainy.
Example: Yaoundé is warm and often cloudy. It rains frequently.

questions.reponse: Example: The far north is very hot and dry. It is sunny most of the year.

intitule: Exercise 5: Describing Seasons and Their Characteristics

enonce.texte: Write a short paragraph of 5 sentences describing your favorite season in Cameroon and why you like it.

questions.reponse: Example: My favorite season is the rainy season. It is not too hot. The rain makes the plants grow. I like the fresh air. Also, the food is very good during this season.

intitule: Exercise 7: Talking About Weather Around the World

enonce.texte: Compare the weather in Cameroon with the weather in two other countries. Use the present simple and time expressions.

questions.reponse: Example: In Cameroon, the weather is hot and sunny today. In England, it is cold and rainy. In Australia, it is warm and dry. Tomorrow, it will be sunny in Cameroon but rainy in England.

enonce.texte: Create a weather forecast for the week in your city. Use the present simple and time expressions (today, tomorrow, etc.).

questions.reponse: Example: Today, it is sunny. Tomorrow, it will be rainy. On Wednesday, it is cloudy. On Thursday, it is hot. On Friday, it is windy. On Saturday, it is sunny again. On Sunday, it is cool.
